interpretation: action_lock() uses a separate action-lock SQLite file. Ordinary TaskExecutionLedger.checkpoint() writes task events through its own canonical journal SQLite transaction, without joining that action lock. One independently launched cold process committed a task CHECKPOINT and task event head changed while first process was still within the action_lock context; that same task's stale expected_task_head was later rejected. General action_lock alone is not task-mutator fence, nonce/issuer proof, or atomic provider admission.
